visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-width rotating promo slider: text panel beside a photo, dot navigation, autoplay
visualCharacteristics.summary: Full-width rotating hero: half blue text panel + half photo, dot nav

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide. Cell 1: image (alone in the cell). Cell 2: heading (H2), description paragraph, optional CTA link. Cell order may be swapped; the image cell is detected. Slides rotate every 6 s (paused on hover/focus and with reduced motion); with one row no dots are shown
contentPattern.summary: Hero slider: Interactive rotating slider with dot navigation; each slide has image + text

usage: Home page hero at the top of the page.
reuseGuidance: Use for multi-slide promotional heroes with text + photo. For a single static hero use hero.
